answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened at or to Anathoth beyond listing it: it was given to the priests, Abiathar was sent there, and Jeremiah bought a field there.

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the priests, the children of Aaron
was where Solomon sent the priest Abiathar to his own fields
clauses.quote: Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields

clauses.english: was where Jeremiah bought his cousin Hanameel's field
clauses.quote: I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son

doubts: Left out the verses that only list Anathoth (census, lists of returned exiles and settlers, towns of Benjamin) and the verses naming men from there (Abiezer, Jehu), which say nothing of the place itself.
JER 11:21-23 (men of Anathoth seeking Jeremiah's life) could be a further clause, but I kept the line short.
